name: Foreboding Steamboat
oracle_text:
When this Vehicle enters, each player chooses two nontoken, non-Vehicle creatures they control. Exile them until this Vehicle leaves the battlefield.
Whenever this Vehicle attacks, put a card exiled with it into its owner's graveyard. If you do, investigate.
Crew 2
blocked_sentences: Whenever this Vehicle attacks, put a card exiled with it into its owner's graveyard. If you do, investigate.

needs.what: an op that moves cards matched by an exile-zone selector across every player's exile (here `{"zone": "exile", "controller": "any", "exiled_with": "self", "count": 1}`, the controller picking one) into each card's owner's graveyard, with an `as` binding of what it moved so "If you do, investigate" can be an `if` on that binding
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No op in reference moves an arbitrary exiled card to a graveyard. `search_zones` with `zones: ["exile"]` walks each player's own zones separately and takes `count` per player, so with cards owned by both players it would move one per player instead of one total, and with `player: "you"` it never sees the opponent-owned cards. `return_from_graveyard` defaults its selector to the graveyard and is a recursion op (cause "recursion", no `as`); pointing it at exile is an unshipped misuse. The `process` cost moves only cards an opponent owns and is not limited to cards exiled with this Vehicle. The enters half (for_each_player + choose_permanents + exile until_leaves + leaves_battlefield put_onto_battlefield) and Crew 2 are expressible.
